name: File and Information Management
boundary: General file inventory, document indexing, metadata/keyword organization, duplicate handling, reorganization and archive preparation. Does not replace enterprise records-management compliance, regulated legal retention advice, security incident response, backup engineering, filesystem permissions administration, or host storage execution.
qualification: Two exact v1.1 MIT skill packages have individually verified static text and an in-package federated handoff specification, but 14 taxonomy outcomes remain proposed and require full independent suitability, rights, host behavioral and operational evaluation. 12/12 deterministic oracle examples do not establish model behavior.
